step4.title: Calendar & hours
step4.subtitle: When are you in the chair?
step4.cal_soon_sub: Syncing busy times is coming soon

step5.title: Preferences
step5.subtitle: Pick what LineCatch does for you. You can change this anytime in Settings.
step5.autotext_desc: When a client's call goes unanswered, LineCatch sends them a booking link automatically.
step5.wednesday_desc: Send a midweek check-in to clients who haven't booked in 2+ weeks.
step5.reviews_desc: After a client's second cut, ask them to leave a Google review.
step5.review_url_hint: Find this in Google Business Profile under "Get more reviews."
step5.service_note: Booking confirmations and appointment reminders are always on for clients who opt in.
step5.marketing_desc: Wednesday check-ins, win-back texts, broadcasts and Google review requests. Off until you turn it on.
step5.sticker_note: Marketing texts need a QR sticker at your chair so clients can opt in. We'll ship you one. Everything else works without it, and marketing starts once you scan your sticker.

step6.title: Your portfolio
step6.subtitle: Add your best cuts. Tap any empty spot to add a photo. You can change this anytime with the Portfolio button on your dashboard.

done.title: You're all set!
done.subtitle: Your booking page is live. Head to your dashboard to start catching calls.
